correctness.rationale: On ℓ²(N₀), K=CS-SC has exact strict lower matrix entries -[n(n+1)]^{-1} for k<n, n>=1, zero otherwise. Its dyadic within-block operators -D_j J_{2^j} have s_k~1/(2^j k), via exactly known singular values of the inclusive lower triangular summation L_r: s_k=[2sin((2k-1)π/(4r+2))]^-1. Summing nonzero singular-value counts over dyadic j gives N_B(t)~t^-1/2 and hence s_m(B)~m^-2. Cross-block terms R_j=P_j K Q_j each rank one, ||R_j||<=2^-j, giving exponentially decaying approximation numbers for R and no change in polynomial decay under Ky Fan inequalities both directions. K therefore has s_m~m^-2, S_p membership iff p>1/2, weak S_{1/2} endpoint but not strong; K trace class and zero diagonal yields trace zero. Independently checked finite commutator sections n=8..256 and exact L_r singular formulas r=2..49. No finite section is a proof of infinite decay.
residual_risks: The constants in asymptotic lower/upper estimates are nonsharp; no exact limiting m²s_m coefficient claimed.
Finite section checks are not a theorem about infinite Hilbert-space singular values.
